    B(u,v)[k] = u^T B[k] v  (mod 3).

    (u,z) * (v,w) = (u+v, z+w+inv2*B(u,v)),

Equivalently, F(u,z)=(P u,Q z) is an isomorphism of the two groups and of their pentagon maps. Other valid isomorphisms may exist; any one is accepted.
